blocks.instruction: Leia o texto e escolha a alternativa correta. Algumas perguntas pedem inferência — a resposta não está escrita com todas as letras.
blocks.passage:
AI is already part of how many businesses work. It helps predict customer demand. It can flag unusual transactions. Chatbots answer common questions. AI can also translate documents and suggest the next sales action.

Each use case is specific. AI is rarely the whole answer. It is just one useful piece of the process. The best companies do not chase every AI trend. They pick two or three areas where AI can clearly help. They try small experiments, measure honestly, and expand what works.

Over the next few years, AI will quietly become part of almost every business process. It will not be a revolution. It will be a steady improvement, one use case at a time.

items.q: According to the text, what is one thing AI helps businesses do?
items.why: "It helps predict customer demand."

items.q: What do the best companies do with AI?
options: They use AI for everything at once
They pick two or three areas and try small experiments
items.why: "They pick two or three areas… They try small experiments."

items.q: How does the text describe AI in a use case?
options: Just one useful piece of the process
items.why: "AI is rarely the whole answer. It is just one useful piece of the process."

items.q: The text suggests that companies that chase every AI trend will most likely…
options: waste effort and not focus on what works
get better results than careful companies
items.why: Inferência: o texto elogia focar em poucas áreas, então perseguir toda tendência é o caminho errado.

items.q: The author would most likely DISAGREE with which statement?
options: AI is one useful piece of a bigger process
AI works best when companies focus and measure honestly
AI will change business as a sudden revolution
items.why: Inferência: o texto diz "not as a revolution, but as a steady improvement".

blocks.instruction: Ouça James falando com a nova diretora comercial. Responda sem ler a transcrição — ela só aparece depois de corrigir.

audio.text:
Welcome to the team. You asked me why we invested in only two AI use cases and not in everything at once. Let me explain.

Two years ago, many companies wanted to "do AI" across the whole business. They started ten projects at the same time. Most of those projects were slow, and the results were hard to measure.

We did something different. We chose two clear problems. First, we used AI to flag unusual transactions, so the finance team could check them faster. Second, we used a chatbot to answer common customer questions at any hour.

We started small. We measured the time we saved. When the results were good, we expanded. I think this is why they work today.

My advice to you is simple. Do not chase every trend. Pick two or three areas where AI can clearly help. Run a small experiment first. If it works, expand it. If it does not, stop and learn. In a few years, AI will be part of almost every process here. But it will happen step by step, one use case at a time.
audio.label: Ouça quantas vezes precisar. A transcrição aparece depois de corrigir.

items.q: Why does James say many companies had problems two years ago?
options: They started ten projects at the same time
They did not have enough money
items.why: "They started ten projects at the same time. Most of those projects were slow."

items.q: What were the two AI use cases James's company chose?
options: Flagging unusual transactions and a customer chatbot
items.why: "First, we used AI to flag unusual transactions… Second, we used a chatbot."

items.q: What did James's company do after the small experiments worked?
items.why: "When the results were good, we expanded."

items.q: James suggests that starting small is a good idea because…
options: it is cheaper than hiring people
it avoids using AI at all
you can measure results and only expand what works
items.why: Inferência: ele mede o tempo economizado e só expande quando dá certo.

items.q: How would you best describe James's advice to the new director?
options: In favour of doing everything at once
items.why: Inferência: ele recomenda focar em poucas áreas e testar antes de expandir.

blocks.instruction: O vocabulário da lição aparece aqui em frases novas. Escolha o sentido ou a palavra que cabe no contexto.

items.q: "Fraud detection is a common AI use case." A use case is…
options: a specific way to use something
items.why: Use case = caso de uso: uma forma específica de usar algo.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "The system can ___ unusual transactions and send them to the finance team."
items.why: To flag = sinalizar, marcar algo para revisão.

items.q: "AI can help us predict next month's demand." To predict means to…
options: say what will happen in the future
items.why: To predict = prever, dizer o que vai acontecer.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "We did not want to ___ every new AI ___; we chose only two areas."
items.why: To chase a trend = perseguir uma tendência — foi exatamente o que a empresa evitou.

items.q: "The tool can translate contracts between English and Portuguese." To translate means to…
options: change words from one language to another
items.why: To translate = traduzir, passar de um idioma para outro.

blocks.instruction: Expressões que aparecem em reuniões sobre projetos de AI. Escolha o sentido no contexto.

items.q: "The director will sign off on the new AI project." To sign off on means to…
items.why: Sign off on = aprovar formalmente, dar o aval final.

items.q: "We will roll out the chatbot team by team." To roll out means to…
items.why: Roll out = implementar aos poucos, passo a passo.

items.q: "We started small, then decided to scale up the tool." To scale up means to…
items.why: Scale up = aumentar, expandir para mais áreas.

items.q: "The team agreed the plan but did not follow through." They…
options: did not finish what they started
items.why: Follow through = levar até o fim o que foi combinado.

items.q: "A small chatbot will not move the needle on sales." This means it will…
items.why: Move the needle = fazer diferença perceptível.
